name: fn_parse_coordinates
description: Parse a coordinate written as three decimal components separated by periods, such as 1.2.3. The coordinate must preserve all three numeric components.

name: fn_version_measurement
description: Store a measurement written in version-like notation with multiple decimal points, such as 1.2.3 or 10.25.7. Preserve the complete notation.

name: fn_map_position
description: Record a map position using three numeric components separated by periods, for example 12.34.56. Keep all components of the position.

name: fn_location_value
description: Convert a location value written as multiple decimal components, such as 41.38.2, into a numeric value without removing any components.
